fixture_name: A9 Ballinluig SB signage/VRS-adjacent visibility — real UK Stage 1&2 RSA (Transport Scotland OGL release)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Curve-plus-vegetation forward-visibility loss on a slip-road approach combined with constrained verge passage is a genuine safety issue for drivers entering the taper and pedestrians sharing the corridor.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim (reduced visibility, pedestrian-passage requirement, agreed clearance extension) is verbatim-supported by EV-UK-025; minor caveat that 'both logged problem locations' phrasing exceeds the single quoted section.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a DMRB GG 119 Stage 1 safety concern about visibility and VRU passage, kept categorically distinct from any compliance question.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable—deliver and evidence extended clearance confirming post-clearance driver sight lines and unobstructed pedestrian passage before handover—only loosely worded on 'both' locations.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians explicitly identified as affected road users and centrally served by the recommended unobstructed-passage condition, so VRU impacts are squarely addressed.
